# INV-USD-001 linked to a parked split, with the block claiming 100.00 arrived
# where the bank received 60.00.
#
# `amount:` is an assertion about the money, and this one is wrong. Taking it
# settles the invoice by 60 and leaves it part-paid out of money the file does
# not describe — which is what the fall-short guard exists to catch, and what
# it stopped catching once the settlement's size started coming off the bank
# split while the guard was still handed that account.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal saying the invoice would be left
# part-paid.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-03
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "293a4b5c6d7e8f900112233445566778"
